SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught.en: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.
SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught.fr: Ma fille est si égocentrique.\nElle n'a que quelques amis.

SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught.en: My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.
SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught.fr: Ma fille aime imiter les gens.\nC'est plutôt agaçant.\pSon mimétisme lui a valu le surnom\nde COPYCAT par ici.
